# ClusteredBubbleChart

## Overview

A complete bubble chart visualization that combines ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DataDisplay, ClusteredBubbleGroup, InlineChartKeyGroup, and ChartFooter into a cohesive chart component.

**This component follows the [Organized Props Pattern](./OrganizedPropsPattern.md).**

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `255:8116`
- **Design URL**: [DataVis Components - ClusteredBubbleChart](https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=255-8116)

## Architecture

```
ClusteredBubbleChart (Organized Props Pattern)
├── Layer 1 – Global Modes (modes)
├── Layer 2 – Parent Props
│   ├── chartHeader           → boolean toggle
│   ├── chartFooter           → boolean toggle
│   ├── chartLegend           → boolean toggle
│   ├── dataDisplay           → boolean toggle
│   ├── inlineChartKeyGroup   → boolean toggle
│   ├── interactive, animated
│   └── data, width, height
└── Layer 3 – Child Configs
    ├── chartHeaderConfig          → ChartHeaderConfig
    ├── chartLegendConfig          → ChartLegendConfig
    ├── dataDisplayConfig          → DataDisplayConfig (mirrors DataDisplayProps)
    ├── bubbleGroupConfig          → BubbleGroupConfig
    ├── inlineChartKeyGroupConfig  → InlineChartKeyGroupConfig
    └── chartFooterConfig          → ChartFooterConfig
```

### Component Tree

```
ClusteredBubbleChart
├── ChartAccessibility (wrapper)
│   └── Container
│       ├── ChartHeader (optional, chartHeader=true)
│       ├── ChartLegend (optional, chartLegend=true)
│       ├── DataDisplay (optional, dataDisplay=true)
│       ├── ClusteredBubbleGroup (D3 force bubble layout)
│       │   └── ClusteredBubble[] (circle + inside/outside data labels)
│       ├── InlineChartKeyGroup (optional, inlineChartKeyGroup=true)
│       └── ChartFooter (optional, chartFooter=true)
```

## Import

```tsx
import { ClusteredBubbleChart } from "@jio/datavis-components/charts";
// or
import ClusteredBubbleChart from "@jio/datavis-components/charts/ClusteredBubbleChart";
```

## Data Formats

### Canonical Format (ChartDataPoint)

```tsx
interface ChartDataPoint {
  id?: string; // Unique identifier
  category: CategoryValue; // Bubble label
  value: number; // Size value (determines bubble radius)
  color?: string; // Custom color override
  colorIndex?: number; // Categorical color (1-6)
}

const data: ChartDataPoint[] = [
  { category: "India", value: 4520 },
  { category: "USA", value: 3800 },
  { category: "UK", value: 2100 },
  { category: "Germany", value: 1800 },
  { category: "Japan", value: 900 },
  { category: "Australia", value: 450 },
];
```

## Props Interface (Organized Props Pattern)

```typescript
interface ClusteredBubbleChartProps {
  // Layer 2: Parent Props
  data: ChartDataPoint[];
  width?: number | string;
  height?: number | string;
  chartHeader?: boolean; // Toggle ChartHeader (default: true)
  chartFooter?: boolean; // Toggle ChartFooter (default: true)
  chartLegend?: boolean; // Toggle ChartLegend (default: true)
  dataDisplay?: boolean; // Toggle DataDisplay (default: false)
  inlineChartKeyGroup?: boolean; // Toggle InlineChartKeyGroup (default: false)
  interactive?: boolean; // Enable hover/click (default: true)
  animated?: boolean; // Enable entry animation (default: false)

  // Layer 3: Child Configs
  chartHeaderConfig?: ChartHeaderConfig;
  chartLegendConfig?: ChartLegendConfig;
  dataDisplayConfig?: DataDisplayConfig;
  bubbleGroupConfig?: BubbleGroupConfig;
  inlineChartKeyGroupConfig?: InlineChartKeyGroupConfig;
  chartFooterConfig?: ChartFooterConfig;

  // Layer 1: Global Modes
  modes?: GlobalModes;

  // Accessibility
  accessibility?: AccessibilityConfig;
}
```

| `formatHoverBadgeValue` | `(value: number, category?: CategoryValue) => string` | -          | Custom formatter for hover badge value |

## Usage Examples

### Basic Usage

```tsx
<ClusteredBubbleChart
  data={[
    { category: "Product A", value: 1000 },
    { category: "Product B", value: 750 },
    { category: "Product C", value: 500 },
    { category: "Product D", value: 300 },
    { category: "Product E", value: 150 },
    { category: "Product F", value: 50 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "Revenue by Product",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Distribution of revenue across product lines.",
  }}
  modes={{
    Platform: "L [Laptop 1440]",
    colourTheme: "MyJio",
    colourMode: "Light",
  }}
/>
```

### Full Configuration

```tsx
<ClusteredBubbleChart
  data={marketData}
  width={500}
  height={400}
  chartHeader
  chartFooter
  chartLegend
  dataDisplay
  inlineChartKeyGroup
  interactive
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "Global Market Share",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Customer distribution by country.",
  }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: "static",
    mainLabelValue: "Total Customers",
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: "13,570",
      dataSupportingValue: "/ 15,000",
      supportingLabelValue: "Annual target",
    },
    dataBadgeSemanticConfig: {
      dataBadgeSemanticValue: "+8.5",
    },
  }}
  bubbleGroupConfig={{
    hoverBadge: true,
    minRadius: 15,
    maxRadius: 100,
  }}
  inlineChartKeyGroupConfig={{
    formatValue: (v) => v.toLocaleString(),
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: "Source: CRM Analytics.",
    annotationRightValue: "Q4 2025 data.",
  }}
  modes={{
    Platform: "L [Laptop 1440]",
    colourTheme: "MyJio",
    colourMode: "Light",
  }}
/>
```

### Hover Mode DataDisplay

When `dataDisplayConfig.mode` is set to `"hover"`, the DataDisplay component updates dynamically when bubbles are hovered:

```tsx
<ClusteredBubbleChart
  data={productData}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: "hover",
    mainLabelValue: "Hover a bubble",
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: "--",
      dataSupportingValue: "/ 2,750",
      supportingLabelValue: "of total revenue",
    },
    dataBadgeSemanticConfig: {
      dataBadgeSemanticValue: "--%",
    },
    formatHoverLeadValue: (value) => `£${value.toLocaleString()}`,
  }}
  bubbleGroupConfig={{
    hoverBadge: true,
  }}
/>
```

### With Formatted Values

```tsx
<ClusteredBubbleChart
  data={revenueData}
  bubbleGroupConfig={{
    hoverBadge: true,
    hoverBadgeConfig: {
      formatValue: (value, label) => {
        const formatted = `£${(value / 1000000).toFixed(1)}M`;
        return label ? `${label}: ${formatted}` : formatted;
      },
    },
  }}
  inlineChartKeyGroupConfig={{
    formatValue: (v) => `£${(v / 1000000).toFixed(1)}M`,
  }}
/>
```

<ClusteredBubbleChart

## Design Tokens Used

| Token Path                      | Purpose                                             |
| ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `Dimensions/Spacings/5`         | Gap between chart sections (20px)                   |
| `categorical/bold/1-6`          | Bubble, legend, and inline key colors (indices 1–6) |
| `monochromatic/category1-6/2`   | Overflow colors for indices 7+ (cycling per series) |
| `Colour/on-Colour/high`         | Text colors                                         |
| `Typography/fontsize/Title/M`   | Title font size                                     |
| `Typography/fontsize/System/XS` | Body text font size                                 |

## Legend Auto-Generation

### Colour Resolution

All auto-generated legend and inline key items resolve colour using the same overflow-safe logic:

| Item index (1-based) | Token used                                |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| 1–6                  | `categorical/bold/{index}`                |
| 7+                   | `monochromatic/category{(index-7)%6+1}/2` |

Custom `colorIndex` on a data point is used in place of the position index. Explicit `color` strings always take precedence.

### Legend Items

If `chartLegendConfig.items` is not provided, legend items are automatically generated from the data:

- Every data point becomes a legend item (no cap on count)
- Colors are resolved using the overflow-safe logic above
- Use `chartLegendConfig.items` to provide manual items if needed

### InlineChartKeyGroup Items

If `inlineChartKeyGroupConfig.items` is not provided, items are automatically generated:

- Each data point becomes an inline chart key
- Labels come from `category`
- Values are formatted using `inlineChartKeyGroupConfig.formatValue`, else `bubbleGroupConfig.valueFormat` (the same format driving the bubbles' own `DataLead` values), else `toLocaleString()`
- Colors match the legend/bubble colors using the same overflow-safe resolution

## Height Behavior

The `height` prop controls the height of the bubble visualization area. The ClusteredBubbleGroup fills this space with the D3 force layout; bubbles are sized proportionally within the container.

## Hover Interaction

Hovering over bubbles highlights the bubble and can drive DataDisplay and HoverBadge updates. Set `interactive={true}` (default) and optionally `bubbleGroupConfig.hoverBadge` to show a cursor-following badge.

## Hover Badge

Enable via `bubbleGroupConfig.hoverBadge`. The DataBadge follows the cursor when hovering over bubbles. Use `hoverBadgeConfig.formatValue` or `hoverBadgeConfig.formatBadge` for custom formatting.

## Data-Change Transition

When `animated={true}`, bubbles smoothly resize and reposition when the `data` prop changes after the initial entry animation completes. The `width`, `height`, `left`, and `top` of each bubble transition simultaneously using tokens from the `transitionAnimation` collection (resolved via `useDataTransition`). The D3 force simulation uses deterministic initial positions to ensure consistent layouts across data changes. See [ClusteredBubbleGroup - Data-Change Transition](./ClusteredBubbleGroup.md#data-change-transition) for full token details.

## DataDisplay Integration

This chart supports an optional DataDisplay component above the bubble visualization. When `dataDisplayConfig.mode` is `"hover"`, values update based on the hovered bubble. See **[DataDisplay Integration](./DataDisplayIntegration.md)** for full configuration.

### DataDisplayConfig Migration

```tsx
// BEFORE
dataDisplay={{
  label: "Total",
  leadValue: "1,234",
  badgeValue: "23.5",
  showSupportingValue: false,
}}

// AFTER
dataDisplayConfig={{
  mainLabelValue: "Total",
  dataHead: {
    dataLeadValue: "1,234",
    supportingData: false,
  },
  dataBadgeSemanticConfig: {
    dataBadgeSemanticValue: "23.5",
  },
}}
```

## Accessibility

The chart is wrapped with `ChartAccessibility` which provides:

- ARIA attributes (`role="figure"`, `aria-label`, `aria-describedby`)
- Auto-generated natural language summary
- Visually-hidden data table for screen readers
- ARIA live region (`aria-live="polite"`) for hover/focus announcements
- Roving tabindex keyboard navigation across bubbles
- `aria-controls` linking from bubbles to DataDisplay

### Accessibility Wiring

```
ClusteredBubbleChart
├── useChartAccessibility({ rawLiveText, width, height, isFullWidth })
│     ├→ liveText (debounced via useAriaLiveRegion)
│     ├→ dataDisplayId (stable "-display" id)
│     └→ accessibilityContainerStyle
├── <ChartAccessibility liveText={liveText} containerStyle={accessibilityContainerStyle}>
│   ├── role="figure", aria-label, aria-describedby
│   ├── Visually hidden summary (auto-generated)
│   ├── Visually hidden data table
│   └── <div aria-live="polite">{liveText}</div>
├── <DataDisplay id={dataDisplayId} />
└── <ClusteredBubbleGroup ariaControlsId={dataDisplayId}>
    ├── useRovingTabIndex({ itemCount, orientation, onIndexChange })
    └── <div role="group" aria-label="Chart data">
        └── Bubble[] (role="button", data-roving-item,
                      aria-roledescription="data point",
                      aria-controls={dataDisplayId})
```

### Live Region Announcements

When a bubble is hovered or focused via keyboard, the live region announces:

```
"{category}, {formatted value}, {percentage}% of total"
```

Example: `"India, 4,520, 38.2% of total"`

If `dataDisplayConfig.formatHoverLeadValue` is provided, it is used to format the value in the announcement.

### Keyboard Navigation

```
Tab into chart  →  First bubble receives focus (tabIndex=0)
                    All other bubbles: tabIndex=-1
ArrowRight/Left →  Focus moves to next/prev bubble (wraps around)
Home / End      →  Focus moves to first/last bubble
Enter / Space   →  Triggers bubble click handler
Tab out         →  Exits the bubble group entirely
```

### Usage

```tsx
<ClusteredBubbleChart
  data={data}
  accessibility={{
    enabled: true,
    dataTable: true,
    summary: "Custom summary override",
  }}
/>
```

No additional props needed — live region, roving tabindex, and all ARIA semantics activate automatically when `enabled: true` (default).
